member.name: MarkdownEmitters.Remarks
member.para: The Markdig parse and the toolkit-neutral mapping decisions live in the engine-neutral , and the layout decisions (spacing, heading size, list markers, spacing suppression, table structure) live in the render plan that builds from the model. This emitter only resolves the toolkit concerns (fonts, brushes, element types) while it walks that plan, and code blocks are delegated to .

All members create and touch the toolkit's elements and must run on the UI thread that owns the target elements. The caller normalizes line endings and owns the plain-text fallback behavior; a parsing or rendering failure propagates to the caller.
